featured_reviews.name: Khan Hasan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very Bad Experience – Extremely Disappointed and Angry!

This has been one of the worst experiences ever! I placed an order 3rd of november, scheduled for delivery 4th of november between 6:00 PM and 9:00 PM. Suddenly, I received an OTP, and when I checked, the message said the order was returned! Returned? How can you return something that was never even delivered to me?

This isn’t just any order — it’s medicine for a patient who suffered a brain stroke, prescribed by a neurosurgeon. The delivery was urgent and critical! Because of your careless service, the patient’s health was put at risk.

What’s even more frustrating is that your store is only two kilometers away — just a 26-minute walk or 10 minutes by two-wheeler! Despite being so close, you couldn’t deliver the order and had the nerve to mark it as returned.

If this is how your service works, then what’s the point of creating an online app at all? People trust you with essential items, and you completely failed to deliver — literally! Absolutely unacceptable and irresponsible behavior.
